modules.reason: A recorded pursuit persists between decider choice points without a new answer each minute. Explicit stop or another chosen activity ends it, as do target departure, indoor separation and the existing bounded lost-target rule. A missing or refused model answer creates no pursuit and does not cancel one already recorded. Version 2 retains its per-minute keepalive requirement for exact replay; only new societies record this version.

The purposeful planner retains version 2's capability gates and reads each kind's wait, stand, talk, rest and visit weights for its autonomous choices. Missing weights are zero, and no weighted activity available means waiting. Both beings must prefer talk for a routine pairing. Tiredness still prefers reachable rest where the kind can rest; waiting still yields occupied places. Explicit owner and decider choices are not restricted by preference, and other abilities' weights remain unexecuted. Earlier module versions retain their recorded choices.

The purposeful planner's choices as version 3 makes them, and a being placed by the world's author is taken in only outdoors: at the open node nearest where it was put down that is no door's node (one every edge of which is the way to a door), never in a shop's doorway, since a placed being has no day and never goes in. The stand a being would be put down at is read by the same rule. Earlier module versions retain their recorded take-ins.

The purposeful planner's choices and take-ins as version 4 makes them, and a town's residents start their first minute at home: at genesis each of the ground's population the town's people give a home starts outdoors, in ordinal order, at the node nearest their own home's door of those anybody new may start at (clear of where a person arrives and of every destination) that nobody stands at yet; one with no such node left keeps the place genesis spread it to. Nobody is placed for a view. Earlier module versions start their people where they always did.

modules.reason: Who a being its world's owner placed is, as the owner writes it beside the placed thing: a name, a few words about it, or both, held to the line rule and refused where it carries a name the account holder saved. A society that records it carries the newest character of each placed being in its inputs, copies it into the being's state, and shows it to that being's decider alone, quoted as fiction its owner wrote and never as instructions; every other being still calls it by what it is. It holds nothing a society derives and records no event. A society made before it shows no character.
